name: Manappuram Finance Ltd
about: Manappuram Finance is a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC), which provides a wide range of fund based and fee based services including gold loans, money exchange facilities, etc. The Company is a Systemically Important Non-Deposit taking NBFC(NBFC-ND).(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:120)
key_points: Joint Promoter [1] [2] [3] In Mar 2025, the company entered into a definitive agreement with Bain Capital for a strategic investment of Rs. 4,385 Cr through a preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants, enabling Bain Capital to acquire an 18% stake on a fully diluted basis, with a mandatory open offer for an additional 26% stake. It received the requisite approvals from the Reserve Bank of India in Mar 2026. It has received Rs. 2,740 Cr in equity infusion from Bain Capital in Mar 2026, while the remaining Rs. 1,644 Cr towards share warrants is expected over the next 4-18 months. Upon completion, Bain Capital became a joint promoter alongside the existing promoters, with board representation and joint control of the company.

profile.summary: Manappuram Finance Limited, a gold loan non-banking financial company, provides fund-based and fee-based financial services in India. It operates through Gold Loan and Others, and Microfinance segments. The company offers loans, such as gold loans, gold loans at your doorstep, online gold loans, business loans, home improvement loans, housing loans, property loans, income-generating loans, and personal loans; balance transfers and top-ups; and co-lending arrangements. It also finances commercial and passenger vehicles, construction and farm equipment, and two-wheelers, as well as micro, small, and medium enterprises. In addition, the company offers foreign exchange money transfer and digital wallet services, as well as other services, such as depository services and demat account services. It serves salaried professionals, self-employed individuals, retail customers, and gold jewelry holders; small and medium-sized enterprises, large corporate entities, and institutional clients across the education and health sectors; and micro and small entrepreneurs engaged in trading and manufacturing activities. The company was formerly known as Manappuram General Finance and Leasing Limited and changed its name to Manappuram Finance Limited in 2011. Manappuram Finance Limited was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Thrissur, India.
